data.summary: Sprachforum Beispiellahn e.V. confirms interest in the evening German B1 course starting 12 January 2027 and asks Kwame to book a placement test slot by 10 December 2026 via a link sent by e-mail.
data.explanation: The language school needs you to take a short placement test before they can enrol you in the German B1 evening course. Use the link in their e-mail to book a test slot. Do this by the deadline shown, since places in the course are limited to sixteen people and registering late could mean missing a spot. If you no longer want to take the course, you can simply not register; no payment is requested in this letter.
